output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Lenovo’s parent/controlling shareholder is Legend Holdings Corporation. Lenovo’s latest annual report states that Legend Holdings and its controlled entities directly or indirectly held 32.04% of Lenovo Group Limited’s ordinary shares as of March 31, 2026. For precision, Lenovo Group Limited is itself the ultimate holding company of the Lenovo Group and its subsidiaries.
caveats: “Parent company” is potentially ambiguous here: Lenovo Group Limited is the ultimate holding company of the Lenovo Group operating subsidiaries, while Legend Holdings Corporation is the controlling shareholder of Lenovo Group Limited.
The 32.04% ownership figure is reported as of March 31, 2026, not as of November 11, 2026.
